newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill lowers AT&T.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill lowers AT&T.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said analyst Daniel Reingold downgraded his near-term rating on AT&T Corp to near-term neutral from above average, keeping a long-term above average rating on the stock.
-- He cut his 1996 earnings per share estimate to $3.46 from $3.60 and 1997 to $3.60 from $3.95.
-- Reingold cited in a report "near-term concerns and competitive pressures especially in the consumer long-distance market."
-- AT&T's shares were off 5-3/8 to 51-7/8 after issuing a warning about its third and fourth quarter earnings.
